posts.title: v0.21 — Multiplayer Rooms
posts.message: Beginning development of multiplayer functionality, including the initial systems for creating and joining player rooms. This update will lay the foundation for future online matches between players.

posts.title: v0.20 — Card Stacking
posts.message: Cards now stack on top of one another when five or more cards are on the table, leaving the edges of previous cards visible for easier viewing and a cleaner table layout.

posts.title: v0.19 — Playtest Fixes: Card Controls, Table Layout, and Inventory
posts.message: Improved card placement and controls, fixed card artwork inconsistencies and unique card inventory issues, and added separate Inventory and Sleeves tabs to deck building.

posts.title: v0.18 — Pixel Art and Card Descriptions
posts.message: Introduced new pixel-art cards and sleeves, shop tabs for Cards, Sleeves, and Unique items, and card descriptions accessible by tapping and holding a visible card.
